geometry: Original simple FREE5 shells retained (8–28 triangles per type). Canonical vertices, faces, normals, UVs, material slots and 19 node bindings are unchanged. No added fine geometry or extra game texture layers.
export: 29 fresh source-reference artwork plates. Recorded crops remove generated presentation padding; each whole chart is resized with Lanczos to its original aspect ratio, maximum 512px. WebP quality70/method6. Original exact-black alpha masks restored with nearest sampling: TH12BOX has1378 black source pixels; other new charts are opaque. Both accepted images and the native flat retain their existing bytes.

TH25HAN.basis: Recovered from the original TH25HAN glyph strip after rechecking. Earlier generic draft rejected.

TH25HA1.basis: Related canonical TH25HAN confirms the hangar name; retained the existing two-line side label.

TH14SBA1.basis: Contextual reconstruction of the unresolved original field after related facade comparison; not confirmed original words.
TH14SBA1.badges: Original red/yellow crest footprints retained without asserting Shell branding.

TH08PBLB.basis: Contextual reconstruction in the existing two fascia word groups. Original lettering is effectively one dark pixel row; wording remains unconfirmed.

lettering.TH12BOX: Confirmed THRUXTON / CIRCUIT; existing upperleftcheckeredmotif andcutout retained.
lettering.Mobil1: Original logo counts and footprints retained; explicit numeral1 on the original banners/posters.

uv_contract.replacement: Exact original BMP name/size/CRC32 guard; one image per identity, no UV or slot remap. Same-named Knockhill variants retain their previous bytes.
uv_contract.edge_samples: TH07LB3 bottom edge remains quiet tan/grey; TH14SBB bottom edge remains warm dark brick; TH21LHR7 top edge remains olive. Original point/line UVs retained with native .02..99 clamping.
uv_contract.TH37AIR: TH12BOX_1 faces20–22 use constant original UVs, effectively(.02,.99). Existing accepted image remains byte-identical; these faces use only its pale corner.
uv_contract.shared_consumer: TH28LAB5 also feeds TH15TSTE_1 mesh20/node57. Material checked there without accepting that entire additional M07 type.

limits: Only the listed19 M07-2 types/19 bindings are accepted.18 M07 types/36 bindings remain open; vegetation, barriers, people and flags remain separate. Vehicles and cockpits are outside this package. Canonical references unchanged; no original game images committed and no performance measurements.
